notes: Customer utterances are written the way Sarvam STT returns them (Devanagari Hindi, English loanwords often in Devanagari; English sentences in Latin script).
Utterances derived from real calls are paraphrased; no real customer name, number or address is used. 'source_calls' are conversation IDs for evidence only.
Text mode (run_text_cases.py) uses only 'say' turns. Voice mode (run_voice_cases.py) also honours timing fields: after=bot_done|bot_start|immediate, delay (s), silence (s), hangup, voice, noise.

Expectations: outcome_in / outcome_not_in (workflow 'outcome' slot), must_close, open_ok, say_any / say_all / say_none (regex over bot replies after the greeting), max_identity_asks, intro_has (regex over the first business reply), nodes_none.
